title: Settings
resetBody: Schedules and records you created will not be deleted.

general.label: General
general.description: Set language, appearance, and navigation in one place.
general.languageHint: Choose the language used in the app
general.helpSectionHint: See input examples and how each feature works.
general.languageSectionHint: Choose the language used in the app.
general.appearanceSectionHint: Set the app theme and accent color.

ai.label: AI
ai.description: Set AI Planner and natural-language input.
ai.plannerHint: Set work hours and personalized suggestions.
ai.inputHint: Set Home input and auto-classification defaults.
ai.behaviorHint: Choose how analysis results are saved.
ai.workHoursHint: Your settings take priority over AI suggestions.

planning.useHistoryHint: Only titles you edited by hand at least twice use their recent duration and priority. This is not automatic learning; you confirm before it applies.
planning.saved: Personalization saved. It applies to new plans.
planning.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Your settings are kept, so please try again.
planning.notConnected: Check your sign-in and server connection. Nothing was saved yet.
planning.loginExpired: Your sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.
planning.invalid: Check your work hours, date range and placement settings.

calendar.label: Calendar
calendar.description: Manage schedule defaults and Google Calendar.
calendar.googleHint: Manage Google Calendar connection and sync.

planning.label: AI Planner
planning.description: Set work hours and personalized suggestions.

account.label: Account
account.description: Manage your profile and sign-in details.
account.profileHint: Manage your name and profile image.
account.managementHint: Sign out or delete this account.
account.name: Name
account.imageTooLarge: Please upload an image of 350KB or less.
account.signOutFailed: Could not sign out. Please try again.
account.deleteAccountConfirm: This deletes the account and every record saved on the server right away. It cannot be undone; signing up again with the same email starts a new, empty account.

appearance.label: Appearance
appearance.description: Set the app theme and accent color.
appearance.themeNote: An applied custom theme overrides the colors below.
appearance.colorLimit: You can save up to 8 colors. Delete one before saving another.
appearance.colorHint: Pick a color, then save it. Saved colors appear below.

navigation.label: Navigation
navigation.mobileHint: Choose up to five tabs and use the arrows to reorder them. Other menus appear in More, at the top left. Menus hidden below are also hidden on mobile. Changes save automatically.
navigation.mobileEmpty: Do not show on the bar
navigation.hint: Drag rows to reorder. Custom Templates and Settings stay at the bottom.

googleCalendar.label: Google Calendar
googleCalendar.description: Manage Google Calendar connection and sync.

categories.label: Categories
categories.description: Manage parent and child categories, colors, and icons.
categories.listHint: Change colors and icons directly on each item.

input.label: Input & AI
input.description: Set Home input and auto classification.
input.autoClassifyHint: When off, Home saves only after you pick a type.
input.autoSaveHint: When off, review the result before saving.
